approximationNotes: Two broadside images do not metrically determine hidden thickness or internal bolt geometry.

Strict CS2 silhouette target 0.90 is not yet met; the current deterministic front mask is 0.8081 after the source-traced scope, folded-bipod, matte-optic, ocular-taper, mirrored ring-face, and rearward bolt-handle correction.

The scope crown foil, mirrored ring faces, turret collar, hinge plate, locking lug, continuous bipod tubes, coil spring, and feet are separate real volumetric parts; the scope-only crop supports a matte graphite response but residual contour differences remain visible in the broadside comparison.
Medusa paint is a shell-only curved projection from supplied pixels; it is not used as structural geometry.
The thumbhole is a real extruded stock cut with a projection cutout; hidden thickness and interior hardware remain inferred.
